mentions.name: Michigan Pulse
mentions.description: A community-driven data aggregation platform for the Michigan tech ecosystem, currently live as a promo page. Planned launch features include a company index, a curated newsletter, and educational resources covering Michigan programs such as CS programs.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am building a community driven data aggregation platform for the Michigan tech ecosystem. This is just a promo page.

On launch there will be a company index, curated newsletter, educational resources in michigan like CS programs, and much more!
